summary: One frozen candidate commit means the cumulative tree at the single final HEAD a53fbef70d20e6ee49f1ebd2ee783c991f95a7b4, which carries every v26 change since 50fcd57, not one commit since 50fcd57.
accepted_exception: Two git-ignored classes inside the candidate are the accepted exception to D-03; neither is twin-attested source and neither changes HEAD, the tree or the porcelain status: (1) _build output written by the example-host warm compile and by verify_twin; (2) the pre-existing example-host SQLite files examples/phoenix_host/crosswake_example.db, crosswake_example.db-shm and crosswake_example.db-wal, which the run is not expected to write because verify_twin gives its ecto.migrate and phx.server children a DATABASE_PATH inside the run root (twin_runtime.ex:140 and 551-552, twin_journey.ex:228-241), and whose size and sha256 are recorded before the launch and after the exit.
